config_comparison.matching_key: Geometry/aspect/material/quarter/foreign/role/distance schedule/camera sign/sham direction/selectedCF/extent/margin/depth/roll; excludes camera angle magnitude, actual dimensions, appearance seeds and asset/fold.
config_comparison.no_factor_isolated_by_split: Camera angles, positive axis dimensions, and appearance/light/background seeds all change together; causal attribution to one factor is not identified.

semantic_scope: Constructed continuous endpoint + camera-facing active subset of37registeredwitnesses; D/E are not query-pixel occupancy. All37-nearest-background metadata cannot identify which active witness aliases.
crop_extent_scope: Only analytic containment of projected active-witness bbox in input sampling-centre extents; not evidence pixels/colors/features preserve the witness.
